required checks pass

authorization boundary is inside the operating scope

supporting implementation exceeds remaining user-facing work

same candidate and cause
no materially different hypothesis

given: No explicit attempt or cost budget exists.

cases.prompt: The work took longer than an hour but the latest probe resolved an acceptance risk. Continue or stop?
given: No user or project deadline was set.
A bounded next action follows directly from the new evidence.

cases.prompt: The user allowed at most two paid target runs. Both have been used; a new hypothesis requires a third paid run.
given: The limit is explicit and no extension is authorized.
Independent local inspection remains authorized and costs no target run.

cases.prompt: A mandatory access-control boundary takes more code than the remaining one-line export call. Should it be deleted as scope inversion?
given: Access control is part of the DoD.
The implementation is the existing project pattern, not a generic framework.

cases.prompt: The DoD and required checks pass, and the changed diff contains no unnecessary additions. Finish the task.
given: No optional cleanup was requested.
